sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Missam forklift key (Danex) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A Missam forklift key. The name of the former owner is written on the ribbon.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - This key does currently not open any lock. It's a quest item only.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - 1 needs to be found in raid for the quest Collector

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs
- In Sport bags

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- Easter eggs and References:
  - "Missam" is a parody of Nissan.
  - The item is a reference to the content creator DanExert.
